Button.name: children
Button.description: Visible label; it is also the accessible name.

Button.name: intent
Button.description: Meaning of the action. Defaults to `'default'`; mark the main action of a view with `'official'`.

Button.name: size
Button.description: Defaults to `'medium'`. Every size is at least 32 px high, above the WCAG 2.2 minimum target.

Button.name: loading
Button.description: Operation in progress: shows a ring in place of `startIcon`, sets `aria-busy` and ignores activation, but the button keeps its look and its focus. Use it instead of `disabled`, which means the action is unavailable.

Button.name: startIcon
Button.description: Decorative content before the label, typically an `Icon`.

Button.name: fullWidth
Button.description: Takes the full width of its container.

IconButton.name: label
IconButton.description: Accessible name, e.g. `'Close'`: what the action does, not what the icon shows. Cannot be blank.

IconButton.name: children
IconButton.description: The icon. It is hidden from assistive technologies, since `label` names the button.

IconButton.name: size
IconButton.description: Square side of 32, 40 or 48 px; the icons take the matching `iconSize` token. Defaults to `'medium'`.

IconButton.name: loading
IconButton.description: Operation in progress: the icon becomes a ring; see `Button`.

CopyButton.name: value
CopyButton.description: Text written to the clipboard, or a function that returns it at the moment of the copy.

CopyButton.name: label
CopyButton.description: Name of the button for what it copies, e.g. `'Copy code'`. Defaults to `labels.copy`. Cannot be blank.

CopyButton.name: showLabel
CopyButton.description: Shows the name next to the icon. Defaults to `false`: the icon alone.

CopyButton.name: feedbackDuration
CopyButton.description: Time the confirmation stays before the button returns to rest. Defaults to `2000` (ms).

CopyButton.name: onCopyFailed
CopyButton.description: Called when the clipboard refuses the text.

CodeBlock.name: showLineNumbers
CodeBlock.description: Numbers each line; the numbers are never copied. Defaults to `false`.

CodeBlock.name: copyable
CodeBlock.description: Shows the copy button. Defaults to `true`.

CodeBlock.name: code
CodeBlock.description: Tokens from `highlightCode`, or a string shown without colors.

CodeBlock.name: fileName
CodeBlock.description: Shown above the code and used as its accessible name.

CodeBlock.name: highlightedLines
CodeBlock.description: Numbers of the lines to highlight, from 1.

CodeBlock.name: files
CodeBlock.description: The files, one tab each, in order; the copy button copies the file shown.

CodeBlock.name: file
CodeBlock.description: Name of the file shown, to control it.

CodeBlock.name: defaultFile
CodeBlock.description: Name of the file shown at first when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first file.

CodeBlock.name: onFileChange
CodeBlock.description: Called with the name of the file the reader picks.

Avatar.name: name
Avatar.description: Name of the person or entity: the accessible name and the source of the initials. Cannot be blank.

Avatar.name: src
Avatar.description: Image URL. Without it, or when it fails to load, the initials are shown.

Avatar.name: intent
Avatar.description: Color of the initials, on its soft container. Defaults to `'default'`.

Avatar.name: decorative
Avatar.description: Hides the avatar from assistive technologies when the name is already next to it.

Badge.name: label
Badge.description: What the badge means, e.g. `'3 unread messages'`, read in place of the visual count.

Badge.name: decorative
Badge.description: The anchor already says what the badge means, so the badge is not announced.

Badge.name: children
Badge.description: Element the badge is attached to.

Badge.name: content
Badge.description: Number or short text. Numbers above `max` show as `max+`.

Badge.name: showZero
Badge.description: Shows a count of 0, which is hidden by default.

Badge.name: invisible
Badge.description: Hides the badge, e.g. when there is nothing new.

Card.name: as
Card.description: Defaults to `'div'`. A `section` or `article` without a `CardHeader` needs an `aria-label`.

Card.name: variant
Card.description: Defaults to `'outline'`, separated by the border; `elevated` adds a shadow, e.g. for a card over other content.

CardHeader.name: title
CardHeader.description: Heading of the card; it names a `section` or `article` card.

CardHeader.name: avatar
CardHeader.description: Content before the title, e.g. an `Avatar`.

CardHeader.name: action
CardHeader.description: Controls at the end of the header, e.g. an `IconButton`.

CardHeader.name: headingLevel
CardHeader.description: Level of the title heading; pick it from the document outline, not from the size. Defaults to `3`.

Carousel.name: label
Carousel.description: Accessible name of the carousel, e.g. `'Featured reports'`. Cannot be blank.

Carousel.name: index
Carousel.description: Index of the visible slide, when the parent controls it.

Carousel.name: defaultIndex
Carousel.description: Initial slide when uncontrolled. Defaults to `0`.

Carousel.name: onIndexChange
Carousel.description: Called with the index of the slide that should become visible.

Carousel.name: loop
Carousel.description: Goes from the last slide to the first and back. Defaults to `false`.

Chip.name: label
Chip.description: Visible text; it is also the accessible name of the chip and of its button.

Chip.name: intent
Chip.description: Meaning of the attribute or status. Defaults to `'default'`.

Chip.name: variant
Chip.description: Defaults to `'soft'`. A selected chip is always a `solid` `brand` chip with a check mark.

Chip.name: disabled
Chip.description: Dims the chip and disables its buttons.

Chip.name: selected
Chip.description: Makes the button a toggle (`aria-pressed`), e.g. a filter; needs `onClick`.

Chip.name: onDelete
Chip.description: Adds a delete button after the label.

Chip.name: deleteLabel
Chip.description: Name of the delete button, e.g. `'Remove Status: open'`; needs `onDelete`.

Divider.name: orientation
Divider.description: Defaults to `'horizontal'`. A vertical divider stretches to the height of its flex row.

Divider.name: decorative
Divider.description: Hides the line from assistive technologies when it only decorates, e.g. between items that are already grouped by headings or lists. Defaults to `false`: the divider is announced as a separator.

List.name: ordered
List.description: Renders an `<ol>`, for lists whose order means something (a ranking, steps). Defaults to `false`.

List.name: divided
List.description: Draws a line between the items. Defaults to `true`.

ListItem.name: title
ListItem.description: Main text of the item. Links and buttons go here or in `trailing`, never around the whole item.

ListItem.name: leading
ListItem.description: Content before the text, e.g. an `Avatar` or an icon.

ListItem.name: trailing
ListItem.description: Content after the text, e.g. a value, a `Chip` or an `IconButton`.

StatCard.name: label
StatCard.description: What is measured, e.g. `'Revenue'`. It names the card.

StatCard.name: value
StatCard.description: The value, formatted for the locale.

StatCard.name: description
StatCard.description: Context of the value or of the change, e.g. `'vs. last month'`.

StatCard.name: icon
StatCard.description: Decorative icon at the end of the label.

StatCard.name: loading
StatCard.description: Shows a placeholder in place of the value and the change. Defaults to `false`.

Skeleton.name: shape
Skeleton.description: `text` is one line of the surrounding font size; `circle` has the `width` as diameter. Defaults to `'text'`.

Skeleton.name: width
Skeleton.description: CSS length. Defaults to the full width (`text`, `rectangle`) or `2.5rem` (`circle`).

Skeleton.name: height
Skeleton.description: CSS length. Defaults to one line (`text`), `6rem` (`rectangle`) or the width (`circle`).

SkeletonText.name: label
SkeletonText.description: Announced when the placeholders appear. Defaults to the provided `loadingStatus.loading`, or `'Loading'`.

SkeletonList.name: withLeading
SkeletonList.description: Shows a circle before each row, as for an `Avatar`. Defaults to `false`.

SkeletonList.name: label
SkeletonList.description: Announced when the placeholders appear. Defaults to the provided `loadingStatus.loading`, or `'Loading'`.

EmptyState.name: title
EmptyState.description: What is missing or what went wrong, in a few words.

EmptyState.name: description
EmptyState.description: What it means and what the user can do next.

EmptyState.name: icon
EmptyState.description: Decorative icon in place of the default glyph.

EmptyState.name: headingLevel
EmptyState.description: Renders the title as a heading of this level, when the state replaces a whole section of the page. Without it (default), the title is a paragraph, as inside a table or a card that already has a heading.

ErrorState.name: announce
ErrorState.description: Announces the error when it appears (`role="alert"`). Defaults to `true`; turn it off when the error is part of the page from the first render, e.g. rendered by the server.

ErrorState.name: onRetry
ErrorState.description: Shows a retry button that calls it, unless an `action` is given.

ErrorState.name: title
ErrorState.description: What is missing or what went wrong, in a few words.

ErrorState.name: description
ErrorState.description: What it means and what the user can do next.

ErrorState.name: icon
ErrorState.description: Decorative icon in place of the default glyph.

ErrorState.name: headingLevel
ErrorState.description: Renders the title as a heading of this level, when the state replaces a whole section of the page. Without it (default), the title is a paragraph, as inside a table or a card that already has a heading.

Table.name: caption
Table.description: Name of the table, rendered as its `<caption>`. Required: every table needs a name.

Table.name: hideCaption
Table.description: Hides the caption visually; it still names the table for assistive technologies. Defaults to `false`.

TableHeaderCell.name: scope
TableHeaderCell.description: `col` (default) for column headers; `row` for the cell that names a row, e.g. its first column.

TableHeaderCell.name: onSort
TableHeaderCell.description: Makes the header a sort button. The parent updates `sortDirection`, and usually the rows, in response.

TableHeaderCell.name: sortDirection
TableHeaderCell.description: Direction the table is sorted by this column, or `null` when it is sorted by another one.

DataTable.name: processing
DataTable.description: Who sorts, filters and pages the rows: the table (`client`) or the server. Defaults to `'client'`.

DataTable.name: rowCount
DataTable.description: With `processing="server"`, the number of rows that match, across every page.

DataTable.name: caption
DataTable.description: Name of the table. Required: it also names the scroll region and the pagination.

DataTable.name: hideCaption
DataTable.description: Hides the caption visually, e.g. under a heading that says the same. Defaults to `false`.

DataTable.name: density
DataTable.description: Defaults to `'comfortable'`.

DataTable.name: columns
DataTable.description: Keep the same array between renders (a constant or `useMemo`): the search index depends on it.

DataTable.name: rows
DataTable.description: Every row, or only the current page with `processing="server"`. Keep the same array between renders too.

DataTable.name: getRowId
DataTable.description: Stable key of each row.

DataTable.name: status
DataTable.description: Defaults to `'ready'`.

DataTable.name: errorDescription
DataTable.description: Explanation under the title of the error state.

DataTable.name: onRetry
DataTable.description: Shows a retry button in the error state.

DataTable.name: emptyState
DataTable.description: Replaces the default empty state, e.g. with an `EmptyState` that has an action.

DataTable.name: sort
DataTable.description: The sorting, when the parent controls it; `null` for the order of `rows`.

DataTable.name: defaultSort
DataTable.description: Initial sorting when uncontrolled. Defaults to `null`.

DataTable.name: onSortChange
DataTable.description: Called with the new sorting. Each header toggles between ascending and descending.

DataTable.name: page
DataTable.description: The current page (from 1), when the parent controls it.

DataTable.name: defaultPage
DataTable.description: Initial page when uncontrolled. Defaults to `1`.

DataTable.name: onPageChange
DataTable.description: Called with the new page, also when sorting or filtering returns to the first page.

DataTable.name: pageSize
DataTable.description: Rows per page. Defaults to `10`.

DataTable.name: filter
DataTable.description: Text filter: the rows whose `filterValue` contain every word, ignoring case and accents.

DataTable.name: locale
DataTable.description: Locale of sorting and filtering. Defaults to the runtime locale.

DataTable.name: labels
DataTable.description: Overrides some or all of `defaultDataTableLabels`.

DataTable.name: paginationLabels
DataTable.description: Overrides texts of the pagination.

Alert.name: intent
Alert.description: Meaning of the message; it also picks the icon, so the meaning never rests on color. Defaults to `'info'`.

Alert.name: title
Alert.description: Short summary, shown in bold before the message.

Alert.name: action
Alert.description: Action related to the message, typically a small `Button`.

Alert.name: icon
Alert.description: Decorative icon in place of the intent glyph.

Alert.name: onDismiss
Alert.description: Shows a dismiss button that calls it. Removing the alert is up to the parent.

ProgressBar.name: label
ProgressBar.description: Accessible name: what is progressing, e.g. `'Uploading report.pdf'`. Cannot be blank.

ProgressBar.name: value
ProgressBar.description: Current value between `min` and `max`. Leave it out while the duration is unknown (indeterminate).

ProgressBar.name: valueText
ProgressBar.description: Readable value for assistive technologies when a percentage is not meaningful, e.g. `'Step 2 of 5'`.

ProgressBar.name: size
ProgressBar.description: Thickness of the bar (4, 6 or 8 px) or side of the ring (16, 24 or 40 px). Defaults to `'medium'`.

Tooltip.name: content
Tooltip.description: Supplementary text, such as a keyboard shortcut or the full form of a truncated label. Plain text only: a tooltip cannot be focused, so links and buttons inside it would be out of reach.

Tooltip.name: children
Tooltip.description: A focusable element that already has an accessible name of its own (e.g. an `IconButton` with its `label`). The tooltip describes it; it never names it, so nothing essential is lost when the tooltip is not shown.

Tooltip.name: placement
Tooltip.description: Defaults to `'top'`; it flips when there is no room.

Tooltip.name: delay
Tooltip.description: Milliseconds of hover before the tooltip appears; focus shows it at once. Defaults to `300`.

Tooltip.name: container
Tooltip.description: Element that receives the tooltip. Defaults to `document.body`.

Popover.name: title
Popover.description: Visible heading of the popover, which names it.

Popover.name: label
Popover.description: Accessible name of a popover without a heading, e.g. `'Jump coordinates'`.

Popover.name: trigger
Popover.description: The button that opens and closes the popover; it receives `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.

Popover.name: children
Popover.description: Content of the popover: fields, buttons or links, which the keyboard reaches inside it.

Popover.name: open
Popover.description: Open state, when the parent controls it.

Popover.name: onOpenChange
Popover.description: Called with the requested state, on the trigger, Escape or a click outside.

Popover.name: placement
Popover.description: Defaults to `'bottom-start'`; it flips when there is no room.

Popover.name: closeOnOutsideClick
Popover.description: Clicking outside closes. Defaults to `true`; disable it when the popover holds input that would be lost.

Popover.name: initialFocus
Popover.description: Element focused on open. Defaults to the popover itself.

Popover.name: container
Popover.description: Element that receives the popover. Defaults to `document.body`.

Menu.name: trigger
Menu.description: The button that opens the menu, which also names it. It receives `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and, when it has none, an `id`.

Menu.name: placement
Menu.description: Defaults to `'bottom-start'`; it flips when there is no room.

Menu.name: container
Menu.description: Element that receives the menu. Defaults to `document.body`.

MenuItemOption.name: id
MenuItemOption.description: Unique within the menu; used as the React key.

MenuItemOption.name: label
MenuItemOption.description: Text of the item, which names it: a verb for the action, e.g. `'Rename'`.

MenuItemOption.name: onSelect
MenuItemOption.description: Runs after the menu has closed and focus is back on its trigger, so it may open a dialog.

MenuItemOption.name: disabled
MenuItemOption.description: Keeps the item visible but skipped by the arrow keys.

MenuItemOption.name: destructive
MenuItemOption.description: Marks an action that deletes or cannot be undone: error colors, besides a label that says so.

MenuItemOption.name: shortcut
MenuItemOption.description: Keyboard shortcut of the same action elsewhere, e.g. `'Control+C'` (`aria-keyshortcuts` syntax).

MenuSeparator.name: id
MenuSeparator.description: Unique within the menu; used as the React key.

MenuSeparator.name: separator
MenuSeparator.description: Tells the separator from an item.

ContextMenu.name: label
ContextMenu.description: Accessible name of the menu, e.g. `'Actions for report.pdf'`.

ContextMenu.name: children
ContextMenu.description: The element the actions apply to. Make it focusable (`tabIndex={0}`, or a native control), so the keyboard can open the menu too; it keeps its own `onContextMenu` and `onKeyDown`.

ContextMenu.name: disabled
ContextMenu.description: Shows the browser menu instead, e.g. while the element is disabled.

ContextMenu.name: container
ContextMenu.description: Element that receives the menu. Defaults to `document.body`.

Dialog.name: title
Dialog.description: Visible title and accessible name of the dialog (a level 2 heading).

Dialog.name: description
Dialog.description: Text under the title, read with the name when the dialog opens (`aria-describedby`).

Dialog.name: actions
Dialog.description: Buttons at the end of the dialog, the main action last.

Dialog.name: size
Dialog.description: Maximum width: 24, 32 or 48 rem. Defaults to `'medium'`.

Dialog.name: closeOnOutsideClick
Dialog.description: Clicking outside the panel asks to close. Defaults to `false`, since a dialog often holds a form whose input would be lost; enable it for dialogs that only show information.

Dialog.name: hideCloseButton
Dialog.description: Hides the close button of the header; Escape and the actions still close.

Dialog.name: role
Dialog.description: `'alertdialog'` for an urgent message that requires a response. Defaults to `'dialog'`.

Dialog.name: open
Dialog.description: Shows the overlay. The parent owns this state and sets it to `false` in `onClose`.

Dialog.name: onClose
Dialog.description: Called when the user asks to close; the overlay closes only when the parent sets `open` to `false`.

Dialog.name: closeOnEscape
Dialog.description: Escape asks to close. Defaults to `true`.

Dialog.name: initialFocus
Dialog.description: Element focused when the overlay opens. Defaults to the panel itself, so that its name and description are read first; point it to the first field of a short form, or to the least destructive action.

Dialog.name: finalFocus
Dialog.description: Element focused when the overlay closes. Defaults to the element that had focus before it opened (usually its trigger); set it when that element no longer exists, e.g. after deleting the row that opened it.

Dialog.name: container
Dialog.description: Element that receives the overlay. Defaults to `document.body`.

ConfirmDialog.name: size
ConfirmDialog.description: Maximum width: 24, 32 or 48 rem. Defaults to `'small'`.

ConfirmDialog.name: description
ConfirmDialog.description: The consequence, e.g. `'It will be removed for everyone. This cannot be undone.'`.

ConfirmDialog.name: children
ConfirmDialog.description: Additional content between the description and the buttons.

ConfirmDialog.name: intent
ConfirmDialog.description: Meaning of the action; `'error'` marks a destructive one. Defaults to `'official'`.

ConfirmDialog.name: onConfirm
ConfirmDialog.description: Performs the action. While a returned promise is pending, the confirm button is busy and the dialog cannot be dismissed; if it rejects, the dialog stays open so the parent can show the error.

ConfirmDialog.name: onCancel
ConfirmDialog.description: Called on the cancel button and on Escape.

ConfirmDialog.name: open
ConfirmDialog.description: Shows the overlay. The parent owns this state and sets it to `false` in `onClose`.

ConfirmDialog.name: finalFocus
ConfirmDialog.description: Element focused when the overlay closes. Defaults to the element that had focus before it opened (usually its trigger); set it when that element no longer exists, e.g. after deleting the row that opened it.

ConfirmDialog.name: container
ConfirmDialog.description: Element that receives the overlay. Defaults to `document.body`.

Drawer.name: title
Drawer.description: Visible title and accessible name of the drawer (a level 2 heading).

Drawer.name: description
Drawer.description: Text under the title, read with the name when the drawer opens (`aria-describedby`).

Drawer.name: actions
Drawer.description: Buttons at the end of the drawer, the main action last.

Drawer.name: size
Drawer.description: Width (20, 28 or 40 rem) at `start` and `end`, maximum height (40, 60 or 85%) at `top` and `bottom`. Defaults to `'medium'`.

Drawer.name: closeOnOutsideClick
Drawer.description: Clicking outside the panel asks to close. Defaults to `false`; enable it when the drawer holds no input.

Drawer.name: open
Drawer.description: Shows the overlay. The parent owns this state and sets it to `false` in `onClose`.

Drawer.name: onClose
Drawer.description: Called when the user asks to close; the overlay closes only when the parent sets `open` to `false`.

Drawer.name: closeOnEscape
Drawer.description: Escape asks to close. Defaults to `true`.

Drawer.name: initialFocus
Drawer.description: Element focused when the overlay opens. Defaults to the panel itself, so that its name and description are read first; point it to the first field of a short form, or to the least destructive action.

Drawer.name: finalFocus
Drawer.description: Element focused when the overlay closes. Defaults to the element that had focus before it opened (usually its trigger); set it when that element no longer exists, e.g. after deleting the row that opened it.

Drawer.name: container
Drawer.description: Element that receives the overlay. Defaults to `document.body`.

ToastProvider.name: children
ToastProvider.description: The application, whose components show toasts with `useToast`.

ToastProvider.name: placement
ToastProvider.description: Corner or edge of the screen where the toasts appear. Defaults to `'bottom-end'`.

ToastProvider.name: limit
ToastProvider.description: Toasts shown at once; the next ones wait for a free place. Defaults to `3`.

ToastProvider.name: hotkey
ToastProvider.description: Key (`KeyboardEvent.key`) that moves focus to the toasts, and Escape back. Defaults to `'F8'`.

ToastProvider.name: container
ToastProvider.description: Element that receives the notification region. Defaults to `document.body`.

ToastOptions.name: id
ToastOptions.description: Identifies the toast: showing another one with the same `id` updates it in place instead of stacking a copy, and it is announced again only if its text changed. Defaults to a generated identifier.

ToastOptions.name: intent
ToastOptions.description: Meaning of the toast; it picks the icon and how urgently it is announced. Defaults to `'default'`.

ToastOptions.name: title
ToastOptions.description: Short summary in bold before the message.

ToastOptions.name: message
ToastOptions.description: What happened, in a short sentence.

ToastOptions.name: icon
ToastOptions.description: Decorative icon in place of the intent glyph, e.g. an `IconifyIcon` marked `decorative`.

ToastOptions.name: action
ToastOptions.description: Runs the action and dismisses the toast. A toast with an action stays at least 10 seconds.

ToastOptions.name: duration
ToastOptions.description: Milliseconds before the toast dismisses itself, or `null` to keep it until the user dismisses it. Defaults to `defaultToastDurations` of the intent; values below `minimumToastDuration` are raised to it.

ToastAction.name: label
ToastAction.description: Text of the button, a verb such as `'Undo'`.

ToastAction.name: onAction
ToastAction.description: Runs when the button is pressed; the toast is dismissed after it.

ToastApi.name: show
ToastApi.description: Shows a toast, or updates the one with the same `id`, and returns its `id`.

ToastApi.name: dismiss
ToastApi.description: Dismisses the toast with this `id`; focus on it moves to the next toast, or back to where it was before.

ToastApi.name: dismissAll
ToastApi.description: Dismisses every toast, including the ones waiting for a free place.

TextField.name: type
TextField.description: Gives the right keyboard and validation; set `autoComplete` too (e.g. `'email'`). Defaults to `'text'`.

TextField.name: onValueChange
TextField.description: Called with the new text, after `onChange`.

TextField.name: size
TextField.description: 32, 40 or 48 px high, like the buttons. Defaults to `'medium'`.

TextField.name: className
TextField.description: Class of the root of the field.

TextField.name: style
TextField.description: Style of the root of the field.

TextField.name: label
TextField.description: Visible, persistent label; a placeholder never replaces it.

TextField.name: hideLabel
TextField.description: Keeps the label for assistive technologies only, when the context already shows it (e.g. a search bar).

TextField.name: description
TextField.description: Help text, read after the label.

TextField.name: error
TextField.description: Error message. When set, the control is `aria-invalid` and the message, marked with an icon, is read with it. Inside a `Form`, a field with a `name` shows the error of that name unless `error` is given.

TextField.name: required
TextField.description: Marks the label with an asterisk and the control as `required`.

TextField.name: disabled
TextField.description: Unavailable: skipped by Tab and not submitted.

TextField.name: readOnly
TextField.description: Focusable and submitted, but not editable.

TextField.name: loading
TextField.description: The field waits for data (e.g. its options): `aria-busy`, a ring and a hidden `'Loading'` text.

TextField.name: prefix
TextField.description: Before the value, e.g. `'R$'`. Its text is read after the label (by `aria-describedby`), so the name of the field stays its label; an `Icon` marked `decorative` is skipped.

TextField.name: suffix
TextField.description: After the value, e.g. `'kg'`; read like `prefix`.

TextArea.name: resize
TextArea.description: Which way the reader can drag the corner to resize the field. Defaults to `'vertical'`.

TextArea.name: showCount
TextArea.description: Shows how many characters were typed, and the limit when `maxLength` is set. Defaults to `false`.

TextArea.name: size
TextArea.description: Text size of the value; the height comes from `rows`. Defaults to `'medium'`.

TextArea.name: className
TextArea.description: Class of the root of the field.

TextArea.name: style
TextArea.description: Style of the root of the field.

TextArea.name: onValueChange
TextArea.description: Called with the new text, after `onChange`.

TextArea.name: label
TextArea.description: Visible, persistent label; a placeholder never replaces it.

TextArea.name: hideLabel
TextArea.description: Keeps the label for assistive technologies only, when the context already shows it (e.g. a search bar).

TextArea.name: description
TextArea.description: Help text, read after the label.

TextArea.name: error
TextArea.description: Error message. When set, the control is `aria-invalid` and the message, marked with an icon, is read with it. Inside a `Form`, a field with a `name` shows the error of that name unless `error` is given.

TextArea.name: required
TextArea.description: Marks the label with an asterisk and the control as `required`.

TextArea.name: disabled
TextArea.description: Unavailable: skipped by Tab and not submitted.

TextArea.name: readOnly
TextArea.description: Focusable and submitted, but not editable.

TextArea.name: loading
TextArea.description: The field waits for data (e.g. its options): `aria-busy`, a ring and a hidden `'Loading'` text.

PasswordField.name: defaultVisible
PasswordField.description: Starts with the characters visible. Defaults to `false`.

PasswordField.name: onValueChange
PasswordField.description: Called with the new text, after `onChange`.

PasswordField.name: size
PasswordField.description: 32, 40 or 48 px high, like the buttons. Defaults to `'medium'`.

PasswordField.name: className
PasswordField.description: Class of the root of the field.

PasswordField.name: style
PasswordField.description: Style of the root of the field.

PasswordField.name: label
